feed.title: Google Cloud: App Engine flexible environment Java
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: App Engine flexible environment Java

entry.content: Starting from August 2026, to provide modern security patches and support for MySQL 8.4 and later, the App Engine flexible environment uses Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 as the built-in sidecar container for connections to Cloud SQL. To use the latest Cloud SQL Auth Proxy container immediately, restart your VMs or deploy a new version of your application.
entry.summary: App Engine flexible environment is updating its connection method to Cloud SQL Auth Proxy v2 starting August 2026 to support modern security patches and newer MySQL versions. You can adopt this update sooner by restarting your VMs or deploying a new application version.
entry.title: Feature: Update to Cloud SQL connections

entry.content: To improve security, starting in August 2026, App Engine opts your application into TLS version 1.2 and later. You can opt out until the end of August 2026. Starting in September 2026, App Engine might permanently block insecure traffic with TLS version 1.1 and earlier. For more information, see Secure minimum TLS.
entry.summary: To enhance security, App Engine will begin enforcing TLS 1.2 and later for applications starting August 2026. You can opt out until the end of August 2026, after which insecure traffic may be permanently blocked.
entry.title: Feature: App Engine TLS 1.2 Upgrade

entry.content: Support for deploying your existing apps in the flexible environment to Cloud Run using the gcloud beta app migrate-to-run command is in Preview. For more information, see Deploy an App Engine app in the flexible environment to Cloud Run.
entry.summary: Deploy your existing App Engine flexible environment applications to Cloud Run using the `gcloud beta app migrate-to-run` command. This feature is currently in Preview and allows for a smoother transition of your apps. Visit the documentation for detailed migration instructions.
entry.title: Feature: Migrate App Engine flexible to Cloud Run

entry.summary: The Java 25 runtime for App Engine flexible environment is now in General Availability. This update provides access to the latest Java features and improvements for your applications.
entry.title: Feature: Java 25 runtime now available

entry.summary: The Java 25 runtime is now available in preview for App Engine flexible environment. This update provides access to the latest Java features and improvements.
entry.title: Feature: Java 25 Runtime Now in Preview

entry.content: To increase security, starting in March 2025, support for Transport Layer Security (TLS) version 1.1 and earlier is deprecated. Update your application settings in the App Engine flexible environment to use TLS version 1.2 and later, along with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites (Preview).
entry.summary: Starting March 2025, TLS 1.1 and earlier are deprecated. Update your App Engine settings to use TLS 1.2 or later.
entry.title: Feature: TLS Deprecation Update
